name: Spa Virtue
summary: Day spa in Toms River offering body contouring, facials, massage and lash services.
description: Spa Virtue is a beauty and wellness spa on Hooper Avenue in Toms River. Its menu includes Cryoskin, Hydrafacial, body wraps, massage and lash lifts, plus infrared sauna sessions and spa packages.

name: Liu's Kitchen
summary: Chinese and sushi restaurant on Route 88 in Brick with online ordering for pickup and delivery.
description: Liu's Kitchen serves Chinese dishes and a separate sushi menu from its Route 88 location in Brick. Customers can order online for pickup or delivery, and gift cards are available.

name: Solo Bella Brick Oven Bistro
summary: Brick oven Italian restaurant in Jackson with dine-in, takeout, catering and in-house parties.
description: Solo Bella Brick Oven Bistro cooks pizza and Italian dishes in a brick oven at its Chandler Road location in Jackson. It offers dine-in, takeout and delivery, catering, and in-house party packages.

name: Agripas Street
summary: Glatt kosher Israeli restaurant in Lakewood's Westgate Plaza with a chef-driven menu.
description: Agripas Street is a glatt kosher Israeli restaurant in Westgate Plaza on Hillside Boulevard in Lakewood. It features house-made food and bold spices inspired by Jerusalem, with reservations and Uber Eats ordering.

name: Ellie's Indian Curry Corner
summary: Family-owned Punjabi restaurant on Main Street in Toms River, BYOB, with a second location in Belmar.
description: Ellie's Indian Curry Corner serves Punjabi dishes made from scratch at its upper-level Main Street location in Toms River. It is BYOB and offers reservations, pickup, delivery, private events and catering.

name: Ob-Co's Donuts
summary: Walk-up donut stand in Toms River making donuts and crumb cakes fresh daily.
description: Ob-Co's Donuts is a donut stand on Fischer Boulevard in Toms River where customers order at an outside window. The menu covers cake and raised donuts, crumb cakes, platters and coffee, with seasonal flavors.

name: Coastal Dental Group
summary: General and cosmetic dental practice on Bridge Avenue in Point Pleasant, led by Dr. Joseph Zicchino.
description: Coastal Dental Group is a family dental office in Point Pleasant borough, founded in 2004 by Dr. Joseph Zicchino. It offers general, cosmetic and periodontal care along with implants and Invisalign, and takes calls for dental emergencies.

name: Brady & Kunz
summary: Toms River law firm focused on workers' compensation and Social Security disability claims.
description: Brady & Kunz is a Toms River law firm whose attorneys, Thomas Kunz and Terry Brady, handle workers' compensation and Social Security disability cases. The firm also lists personal injury, real estate, criminal defense, family law and wills and estates.

name: Elite Dental Center of Toms River
summary: Family dental office on Hooper Avenue in Toms River offering general, cosmetic and implant dentistry.
description: Elite Dental of Toms River is a family dental practice with Dr. George Lambrinos and Dr. Abe Saff. It treats children and adults, from checkups and crowns to implants, Invisalign and emergency visits.

name: Bridge Veterinary Hospital
summary: Privately owned, AAHA-accredited multi-doctor veterinary practice for dogs, cats and exotic pets in Point Pleasant, NJ.
description: Bridge Veterinary Hospital is a general-practice animal hospital on Bridge Avenue that says it has served the Point Pleasant community since 2015. It cares for cats, dogs and exotic pets such as birds, rabbits and reptiles, with wellness, preventive and diagnostic services.

name: Urban Coalhouse Pizza & Bar
summary: Coal-oven pizza, wings and craft beer on tap at the Route 70 location in Brick, NJ.
description: Urban Coalhouse is a pizza and bar restaurant that cooks its menu in a coal-fired oven. The Brick location serves pizzas, appetizers, dinner plates, craft beer, cocktails and sangria, and also offers catering and private events.

name: Tiny Teeth of Lakewood
summary: Pediatric dental practice on Route 70 in Lakewood, NJ, led by Dr. Zaki Mustacchi.
description: Tiny Teeth of Lakewood is a children's dental office led by pediatric dentist Dr. Zaki Mustacchi. It offers care for kids of all ages, including special-needs patients, and serves families from Lakewood and nearby towns.

name: Epstein's Meats
summary: Family-owned butcher shop on Monmouth Avenue in Lakewood with custom cuts, takeout and catering.
description: Epstein's Meats is a family-owned, full-service butcher shop in Lakewood that says it has been serving customers since 1964. It sells cuts of beef made to order and prepared takeout food, and takes catering orders. Delivery is available on weekdays.

name: Brick Nails and Spa
summary: Nail salon in Brick, NJ offering manicures, pedicures, nail enhancements and waxing.
description: Brick Nails and Spa is a nail salon on Chambers Bridge Road in Brick. It offers manicures, pedicures, gel, acrylic and dip powder services, and signature pedicures, along with waxing.
services: Gel, acrylic and dip powder nails

name: Last Wave Brewing Company
summary: Craft brewery and taproom on Bay Avenue in Point Pleasant Beach, NJ, also selling cans, crowlers and merchandise.
description: Last Wave Brewing Company is a craft brewery with a taproom at 601 Bay Avenue in Point Pleasant Beach. Visitors can buy cans, crowlers and merchandise, and the brewery offers local delivery.

name: Hiering, Dupignac, Dunn & Schreiber, P.C.
summary: Toms River law firm handling estate planning, elder law, land use, and workers' compensation matters.
description: Hiering, Dupignac, Dunn & Schreiber, P.C. is a law firm with an office on Washington Street in Toms River. It represents individuals, families, and businesses across New Jersey in areas such as estate administration, guardianships, and zoning.

name: The Back Stop
summary: Toms River hobby shop buying and selling sports cards, memorabilia, and collectibles.
description: The Back Stop is a collectibles store on Route 37 in Toms River. It buys and sells sports cards, non-sports cards, memorabilia, toys, coins and comic books, and offers paid appraisals.

name: Rosato's Pub & Pizzeria
summary: Pizzeria and pub in Toms River serving pizza and traditional Italian dishes.
description: Rosato's Pub & Pizzeria is a pizza restaurant and pub on Mule Road in Toms River. The menu centers on pizza and traditional Italian-style dishes, and the site lists delivery and catering among its offerings.

name: Pho 34
summary: Vietnamese restaurant on Main Street in Toms River with pho, rolls and vegetarian dishes.
description: Pho 34 serves Vietnamese dishes such as pho, summer rolls and noodle bowls from its Main Street location in Toms River. The menu includes vegetarian and vegan options, and the site offers online ordering for carryout or delivery.

name: Champion Auto Finance
summary: Lease buyout financing for drivers who want to keep the car they are leasing, based in Lakewood.
description: Champion Auto Finance helps drivers finance the purchase of their leased vehicle so they can keep it at lease end. It is based in Lakewood and works with customers nationwide through one application handled privately. Champion Auto Finance is not a lender; approvals and terms are subject to lender underwriting.

name: Glen Kelly Real Estate
summary: Owner-run residential real estate brokerage in Lanoka Harbor handling home sales and purchases in the Ocean County area.
description: Glen Kelly Real Estate is a brokerage with its executive office at Laurel Plaza on Route 9 in Lanoka Harbor. The firm works with buyers and sellers on single-family homes, condos, townhomes and vacant land. Its website also lists relocation help, new construction purchases and home valuations.

name: Dave's Village Auto Repair
summary: Independent auto repair and tire shop on County Road 530 in Whiting, serving Whiting, Beachwood and Toms River.
description: Dave's Village Auto Repair is a vehicle repair shop in Whiting, New Jersey that has operated since 1994. The shop handles brake, electrical, steering and suspension work, and sells and installs tires. It is open weekdays and closed on weekends.

name: Print My Plans
summary: Large-format blueprint and architectural plan printing in Toms River, with one price per sheet at any size.
description: Print My Plans prints architectural plans and blueprints to scale from PDF at 97 Northampton Blvd in Toms River. Sheet sizes run from 18×24 to 36×48 inches, in black and white or color, with no minimum order. Its website lists black and white at $1.95 a sheet and color at $3.75, at any size. Orders placed by 3 p.m. ET ship the same day within the United States. Email support@printmyplans.com. The office is open Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. ET.
services: Black and white and color prints
Full plan sets and multiple copies
Shipping to a jobsite, office or home

name: Boba 8tea8
summary: Boba 8tea8 is a drink shop on Route 88 in Brick that takes pickup and delivery orders and offers catering.
description: Boba 8tea8 operates from Unit 1769 at 1801 NJ-88 in Brick. Its website carries a menu page and links for ordering online for pickup or delivery. The shop also lists catering and posts seasonal opening hours that change between fall and winter and other times of year.

name: Sand Dollar Real Estate
summary: Real estate office on Long Beach Island offering home buying, selling and summer rental services.
description: Sand Dollar Real Estate is an office on North Long Beach Boulevard in Surf City on Long Beach Island. Its website lists local MLS property search, market statistics, and buyer, seller and homeowner rental guides. It also describes summer rental programs and consultations before listing or buying.

name: Tardi's Ristorante Italiano
summary: Family Italian restaurant on Fischer Boulevard in Toms River, open daily for dinner with takeout.
description: Tardi's Ristorante Italiano is a family-run Italian restaurant at 931 Fischer Boulevard in Toms River's Bellcrest Plaza. The kitchen prepares Italian appetizers and entrées to order, with daily specials alongside the regular menu. The restaurant is BYOB, offers takeout, and hosts private parties for groups of up to 40, plus off-premise catering.

name: Manera's Restaurant
summary: Chef-owned restaurant on Cedar Bridge Avenue in Brick serving made-to-order plates, catering and private events.
description: Manera's Restaurant is a chef-owned spot at 950 Cedar Bridge Avenue in Brick. Dishes are prepared fresh to order from a broad menu, and the Brick location lists online ordering along with private-event rooms and catering. A second Manera's location operates in Manahawkin.

name: Royal Grill 37
summary: Family-owned counter restaurant on Route 37 in Toms River serving gyros, kebabs and halal platters.
description: Royal Grill 37 is a family-owned restaurant at 10 Route 37 in Toms River. The open kitchen prepares gyros, kebabs, falafels and halal platters made to order, with house sauces and rice recipes the owners describe as family-made. The shop is open Monday through Saturday.

name: Apache CrossFit
summary: CrossFit gym on Fischer Boulevard in Toms River with group classes, nutrition coaching and teen athletic training.
description: Apache CrossFit is a training gym at 669 Fischer Boulevard in Toms River. Its programs include CrossFit group classes, nutrition coaching and teen athletic performance training, with coaches on the floor for form and scaling. Drop-in workouts are listed for visitors on the website.

name: Nick Catone MMA & Fitness
summary: MMA and fitness training center on Brick Boulevard with boxing, jiu-jitsu, Muay Thai and kids programs.
description: Nick Catone MMA & Fitness is a training center at 781 Brick Boulevard in Brick. The facility lists classes in boxing, Brazilian jiu-jitsu, Muay Thai kickboxing and MMA, plus a kids program and private training. The site describes large mat space, a boxing ring, heavy bags and octagons on the training floor.

name: Lavish Salon
summary: Hair salon on Long Beach Island offering styling, color and bridal services by appointment.
description: Lavish Salon is a hair salon located on South Bay Avenue in Beach Haven. Its services include hair styling, color, formal styling and makeup, along with services for brides and their wedding parties. The salon says it is open year round and asks clients to call to schedule an appointment.

name: Garabedian Realty Group
summary: Real estate brokerage in Surf City on Long Beach Island, handling home sales, purchases and custom home building.
description: Garabedian Realty Group operates from a single office in Surf City on Long Beach Island. The firm represents buyers and sellers in residential sales and investment purchases. It also offers construction management and custom home design and building.

name: Miss Mindy's Homemade Ice Cream
summary: Ice cream shop in Bayville serving homemade ice cream along with dairy-free and no-sugar-added options.
description: Miss Mindy's is an ice cream shop on Atlantic City Boulevard in Bayville. The menu includes homemade ice cream in everyday and rotating flavors, plus dairy-free and no-sugar-added choices. A six-flavor sampler is available, and the shop also takes inquiries about party packages.

name: The Godek Center For Personal Enhancement
summary: Cosmetic plastic surgery practice in Toms River offering facial, breast and body procedures plus non-surgical treatments.
description: The Godek Center for Personal Enhancement is a plastic surgery practice with offices in Toms River and Wall. It provides surgical procedures for the face, breast and body, along with non-surgical options such as injectables, skin treatments and laser services. Appointments can be booked through the practice's website.

name: Anna Bananas Bakery & Candy
summary: Storefront bakery and candy shop in Manahawkin making custom cakes, cupcakes, cookies, pies and party platters.
description: Anna Bananas Bakery & Candy is a local storefront on East Bay Avenue in Manahawkin. It prepares cakes, cupcakes, cookies, pies and galettes, and also runs a candy store. Custom cake and cookie orders can be placed by phone or email, with advance notice requested.

name: Party Fair
summary: Party supply store on Route 37 West in Toms River selling balloons, costumes and decorations for holidays and celebrations.
description: Party Fair is a party supply store located on Route 37 West in Toms River. The shop carries items for birthdays, weddings, showers, holidays and themed events, along with balloons and Halloween costumes. It operates under one name with two other New Jersey stores.

name: A & F Italian Specialties Market
summary: Family-owned Italian market and deli in Forked River serving breakfast, lunch, prepared foods and catering.
description: A & F Italian Specialties Market is a family-owned market on North Main Street in Forked River. It offers a deli counter, house-made sausage and butcher cuts, daily baked bread and prepared foods, with dine-in and takeout available. The market also provides catering for offices and events.

name: Gregory's Seafood Market & Restaurant
summary: Seafood market and dine-in restaurant on Route 37 in Manchester, open daily.
description: Gregory's combines a retail fish market with a dine-in restaurant at one Route 37 location in Manchester. The kitchen prepares dishes to order, and the market posts daily and weekend specials. Seating includes a patio during the summer months.

name: Surf Buggy Bike Shop
summary: Bicycle shop on Long Beach Island offering bike sales, rentals, repairs and cycling accessories.
description: Surf Buggy Bike Shop is a bicycle store on North Long Beach Boulevard in Surf City. The shop sells bikes, including e-bikes, and rents them with advance reservations available. It also handles bike service and repair and carries cycling apparel and accessories.

name: South End Surf 'N Paddle
summary: Family-owned surf shop in Beach Haven selling and renting surf and paddle gear, with lessons and tours.
description: South End Surf 'N Paddle is a family-owned surf shop on Long Beach Island. It sells new and used surfboards, paddleboards, wetsuits, skimboards and apparel, and rents boards and kayaks. The shop also runs surf lessons, kids' camps and stand-up paddleboard tours.

name: Twig Nest and Bloom
summary: Barnegat Light shop selling gallery pieces, accessories and home decor, with commission inquiries accepted.
description: Twig Nest and Bloom is a small shop at 35 West 4th Street in Barnegat Light. Its collected goods are arranged in three groups: gallery items, accessories and home decor. The shop also takes commission inquiries, and its hours vary by season and holiday.

name: Yearbook Records
summary: Record store in Lanoka Harbor selling new and used vinyl, cassettes, CDs and DVDs, and buying music collections.
description: Yearbook Records is a music shop on North Main Street in Lanoka Harbor. The store carries new and used vinyl records, cassette tapes, compact discs and DVD or Blu-ray titles, along with merchandise and gift cards. It also buys collections of vinyl, CDs and cassettes, and asks sellers to get in touch before bringing items in.

name: Chef Justin's Sunset Keys
summary: Bayfront restaurant in Lavallette serving coastal dishes, seafood and steaks for dinner and brunch.
description: Chef Justin's Sunset Keys is a restaurant at 607 Bay Boulevard in Lavallette. The menu centers on coastal cooking, including local seafood, a daily fish selection and steaks, with brunch also described. The restaurant is BYOB and takes reservations, with pick-up and delivery available.

name: The Seawife
summary: Shop at Viking Village in Barnegat Light selling handcrafted folk art, nautical salvage, antiques and garden pieces.
description: The Seawife is a shop at Viking Village in Barnegat Light that sells decorative pieces with a sense of history. Its stock includes American-made folk art, older collectibles, nautical salvage and antique quilts, along with garden items such as birdhouses, urns and iron gates. Visitors can also walk through the gardens on the grounds.

name: Blue Claw Seafood Market
summary: Seafood market on Long Beach Island selling fresh fish, shellfish and homemade prepared items.
description: Blue Claw Seafood Market is a retail seafood shop on Long Beach Boulevard in Surf City. It sells fresh local fish, shrimp, scallops, clams and live or cooked crabs and lobster. The market also offers homemade chowder, crab cakes and salads.

name: Tuckers Tavern
summary: Coastal gastropub in Beach Haven serving American fare, a raw bar, craft beer and cocktails, with indoor and outdoor seating.
description: Tuckers Tavern is a gastropub on South West Avenue in Beach Haven on Long Beach Island. The menu centers on American coastal dishes and a raw bar, alongside rotating craft beers and cocktails. The restaurant offers indoor and outdoor seating, takeout, gift cards and private parties.

name: Stone Fire Grille
summary: Beachwood restaurant serving American-style dishes including tapas, pizzas, burgers and wings, with catering and private events.
description: Stone Fire Grille is a restaurant on Atlantic City Boulevard in Beachwood. Its menu centers on American-style dishes such as tapas, pizzas, burgers and wings. The restaurant also lists daily happy hour specials, live entertainment, online ordering, catering and private event bookings.
